final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count FROM income JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), department_shares AS (SELECT income_count, 1.0 * income_count / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM department_shares) SELECT SUM(income_count) AS combined_count, AVG(department_shares.share) AS average_share, AVG(department_shares.share - average_share.share) AS average_amount_above_average FROM department_shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE department_shares.share > average_share.share
